breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble instruction for defining the grid ('interpret Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints... dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)'), which conflicted with the specific instructions for the periodic domain in section 7. The ground truth resolves this by removing the contradictory preamble sentence. The agent correctly ignored the flawed instruction and generated a specification based on the correct instructions from section 7 ('Use Nx=512 grid points with uniform spacing dx=1/Nx'), thereby resolving the ambiguity in line with the ground truth.
